notes.claim: The law of reflection: the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.
In a flat mirror the image is as far behind the mirror as the object is in front of it.

sources.title: Reflection of waves - Reflection and refraction - AQA - GCSE Physics (Single Science) Revision - AQA - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: The law of reflection states that: angle of incidence = angle of reflection

sources.title: 2.1 Images Formed by Plane Mirrors - University Physics Volume 3 | OpenStax
sources.quote: This means that the distance PB from the object to the mirror is the same as the distance BQ from the mirror to the image.
